div.head: Swer 9
div.ab: On ælmihtiges Godes naman, nyste ic on ðam ðingum, þe þu ymbe specst, ful ne facn, ne wac ne wom, to ðære dæityde, ðe ic hit þe sealde; ac hit ægðer wæs ge hal ge clæne buton ælcon facne.

Að, þæt he nyste ne fuul ne facen. On ealmihtiges Godes naman, nyste ic on ðam ðingum, þe ðu ymbe specst, ful ne facn, ne wac ne wom, to ðære dæigtide, ðe ic hit ðe sealde; ac hit ægðær wæs ge hal ge clæne butan ælcon facne.
Per omnipotentis Dei nomen, ego nesciui in illa re, de qua loqueris, fúl nec facnum nec þác nec þóm illius diei termino, qua tibi uendidi; sed utrumque fuit et hál et clene sine omni facno.

(Eid [des verklagten Verkäufers]: dass er weder Schlechtheit noch Trug [am Verkauften] kannte. B) Im Namen des allmächtigen Gottes, nicht kannt ich an den Sachen, um die du klagst, Schlechtheit oder Trug, nicht Schwäche noch Fehl, zu jener Zeit, da ich es dir verkaufte; sondern es war sowohl heil als [von Anfechtung] rein ohne jeden Trug.

(The oath [of the accused seller]: that he knew of neither foulness nor fraud [in what was sold]. B) In the name of almighty God, I knew of no foulness or fraud in the things about which you complain, no weakness or blemish, at the time when I sold it to you; but it was both sound and clean [of any claim], without any fraud.

[I swear] in the name of Almighty God [that] I knew nothing about things you accuse me of, [and that] on that day there was no deceit, no flaw or defect in what I sold to you – rather it [the sale] was honest and true and without deceit.
